verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat and collaboration platform, so webhooks are a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The closest items are the Nostr relay's WebSocket protocol for third-party clients, the ACP harness listening for @mentions, and YAML workflow automation. These are adjacent mechanisms, not webhooks a programmatic consumer can register and receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
